# docker_secret (Data Source)

Looks up one swarm secret's metadata (`GET /secrets/{id}`) by `id` or `name`; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. The Engine never returns secret data, so `inspect` holds the ID, version, times, name, labels and driver only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Metadata only: the Engine never returns secret data.
data "docker_secret" "db_password" {
  name = "db_password"
}

output "db_password_secret_id" {
  value = data.docker_secret.db_password.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The secret ID or a unique ID prefix; resolved to the full ID. Conflicts with `name`.
- `name` (String) The secret name. Conflicts with `id`.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of inspect_json; changes whenever the object changes.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon the provider talked to (GET /version Version).
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version the provider negotiated with the daemon (GET /version ApiVersion, capped by the client's max).
- `inspect` (Attributes) The secret inspect response as a nested object mirroring Secret field by field (snake_case). Not sensitive: SecretSpec.Data is never returned by SecretInspect. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inspect))
- `inspect_json` (String) The exact Engine API inspect response for the secret, as JSON. Not sensitive: SecretSpec.Data is never returned by SecretInspect.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels on the secret (`Spec.Labels`).
- `version_index` (Number) The secret object's `Version.Index`; it changes on every update.
